tagline: PonyChat · AI companionship with pony characters
intro: Chat one-to-one with pony characters. Memories, voice messages and thoughtful check-ins connect one day to the next, so every conversation has a story to return to.
intro2: Try a light conversation on the web, or get the Android app for character profiles, voice messages and an ongoing companion experience.
international: Made for friendships around the world.
screenshotNote: Screenshots show the Chinese interface. Website language options do not imply full app localization.
shot1desc: Find a character or pick up a recent conversation, all from one familiar list.
shot2desc: Message bubbles, voice replies and quick actions make character conversations part of everyday life.
shot3desc: Layered descriptions of setting, action and emotion give longer scenes room to breathe.
uniqueLead: A familiar messenger, lasting memories, proactive messages and companion play bring shared experiences together.
metric1desc: Voice, notifications and message history make it easy to pick up where you left off.
metric2desc: Important preferences and shared moments can return when they matter.
metric3desc: From chatting alongside you to exploring phone tasks and playing together.
row2a: Often tied to the current context
row2c: History, summaries and lasting memories build continuity
row3c: Check-ins, scheduled follow-ups and continuing topics
row4c: A staged path through chat, phone tasks and games
compareNote: An overview of the product direction. Availability depends on the app version, character settings and development progress.
tier1desc: Text, voice and proactive messages keep your character alongside whatever you are doing.
tier2desc: Exploring screen understanding, finding content and helping with everyday phone tasks.
tier3desc: Starting with slower-paced games, then exploring more responsive decisions, advice and shared actions.
detailLead: Discover what you can experience today and what we are exploring next.
position: A shared past for every conversation
positionText: Characters can remember the topics, preferences and plans you share. PonyChat is built around your ongoing relationship, growing through conversations over time.
memoryDesc: Preferences, shared experiences and relationship cues help future conversations feel connected.
proactiveDesc: Characters can check in, remember plans and continue a topic, including scheduled follow-ups.
voiceDesc: Everyday chat supports spoken replies, playback and text, depending on character and voice settings.
profilesDesc: Explore public characters, portraits, albums and personalities to find someone you want to know.
knowledgeDesc: Relevant everyday conversations can draw on a pony knowledge base to stay closer to the characters’ world.
modelsDesc: Everyday chat uses the server default. Developers and administrators can adjust models in supported modes.
play1desc: Share your day, talk about your mood, or simply say good morning and good night.
play2desc: Start with a character and build your own story through an ongoing conversation.
play3desc: Practice a language, explore ideas and imagine new scenes together.
roadmapText: We continue improving everyday chat, memory and voice. Phone-task assistance and deeper game participation are in development; shared music, video discussions and standalone stories are future explorations.
webScopeText: The website offers information, downloads and light web chat. Character profiles, voice, game modes and the fuller companion experience are primarily available on Android. Chat modes may differ in experience and memory scope.
updatesLead: Continuing to build lasting character companionship for an international audience.
update1desc: The website supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English and Russian. Android downloads are available, with automatic language selection and a manual switch.
update2desc: The temporary account allowlist has been removed. Use the latest Android app to sign in; version requirements may change with releases.
update3desc: PonyChat is connected to Qwen3TTS again, with the character speech synthesis path verified.
mbtiLead: Choose everyday scenarios or an MLP-inspired fan quiz. Answers stay in your browser; these quizzes are for self-exploration and fun.
mbtiStandardDesc: Everyday scenarios and an introduction to sixteen types. Not a clinical assessment.
mbtiPonyDesc: Pony-inspired scenarios and characters. Not affiliated with official MBTI or the franchise owners.
externalNote: Quizzes open in a new tab. Language availability on separate sites may differ.
